metas.name: Waiting Hai
metas.description: Sugam joins the RPF and investigates a Tatkal scam. Hamza and Mama turn booking software into a business, facing rivalry and betrayal. Sugam arrests the agents and tracks Hamza, ending the scam before his escape to Dubai.

metas.name: Bigg Boss
metas.description: Isolated from the outside world, the contestants live together in a house under the live cameras that monitor their every move. They perform various tasks and avoid eviction to be declared a winner.

metas.name: Erotic Stories
metas.description: Erotic Stories is a bold and transgressive anthology series exploring sex and intimacy amongst diverse characters not traditionally seen as sexual leads.

metas.name: Reacher
metas.description: Jack Reacher, a veteran military police investigator, has just recently entered civilian life. Reacher is a drifter, carrying no phone and the barest of essentials as he travels the country and explores the nation he once served.

metas.name: MobLand
metas.description: Two mob families clash in a war that threatens to topple empires and lives.

metas.name: Slow Horses
metas.description: Follow a dysfunctional team of MI5 agents—and their obnoxious boss, the notorious Jackson Lamb—as they navigate the espionage world's smoke and mirrors to defend England from sinister forces.

metas.name: The Mentalist
metas.description: Patrick Jane, a former celebrity psychic medium, uses his razor sharp skills of observation and expertise at "reading" people to solve serious crimes with the California Bureau of Investigation.

metas.name: Lanterns
metas.description: Two intergalactic cops, new recruit John Stewart and Lantern legend Hal Jordan, are drawn into a dark, Earth-based mystery as they investigate a murder in the American heartland.

metas.name: Widow's Bay
metas.description: The mayor of a New England town resolves to turn it into the next tourist hot spot, despite local warnings that it's cursed.

metas.name: Neagley
metas.description: Neagley, drawing from her experience with Jack Reacher and the 110 Special Investigators, embarks on a perilous mission to expose a sinister threat, risking her life to unravel the mystery.

metas.name: Silo
metas.description: Men and women live in a giant silo underground with several regulations which they believe are in place to protect them from the toxic and ruined world on the surface.

metas.name: Mirzapur
metas.description: The iron-fisted Akhandanand Tripathi is a millionaire carpet exporter and the mafia don of Mirzapur. His son, Munna, is an unworthy, power-hungry heir who will stop at nothing to inherit his father's legacy. An incident at a wedding procession forces him to cross paths with Ramakant Pandit, an upstanding lawyer, and his sons, Guddu and Bablu. It snowballs into a game of ambition, power and greed that threatens the fabric of this lawless city.

metas.name: Dark Matter
metas.description: Jason Dessen is abducted into an alternate version of his life. To get back to his real family, he embarks on a harrowing journey to save them from the most terrifying foe imaginable: himself.

metas.name: Off Campus
metas.description: A college-set romantic drama chronicling the unexpected love story between a music student and the university's star hockey player, exploring themes of love and the complexities of adulthood through deep friendships and enduring bonds.

metas.name: Game of Thrones
metas.description: Seven noble families fight for control of the mythical land of Westeros. Friction between the houses leads to full-scale war. All while a very ancient evil awakens in the farthest north. Amidst the war, a neglected military order of misfits, the Night's Watch, is all that stands between the realms of men and icy horrors beyond.

metas.name: Ted Lasso
metas.description: American college football coach Ted Lasso is hired to manage AFC Richmond, a struggling English soccer club, and must win over skeptical players, staff, and fans.

metas.name: Chumbak
metas.description: A young author and quirky support group explore the lives of five families in a Mumbai row-house who laugh, cry, eat, drink, and share everything together, forming a beautiful surrogate family through life's ups and downs.

metas.name: Tehran
metas.description: Tamar is a Mossad hacker-agent who infiltrates Tehran under a false identity to help destroy Iran's nuclear reactor. But when her mission fails, Tamar must plan an operation that will place everyone dear to her in jeopardy.

metas.name: Lioness
metas.description: Cruz Manuelos, a rough-around-the-edges but passionate young Marine, is recruited to join the CIA's Lioness Engagement Team to help bring down a terrorist organization from within. Joe, the station chief of the Lioness program, is tasked with training, managing and leading her female undercover operatives.

metas.name: Broken But Beautiful
metas.description: Broken is Veer and Sameera's story where their hearts were left broken and damaged after they lost their love. Destiny has brought love in to their lives again, will they give it a second chance?

metas.name: Pluribus
metas.description: In a world overtaken by a mysterious wave of forced happiness, Carol Sturka, one of the immune few, must uncover what's really going on - and save humanity from its artificial bliss.

metas.name: India's Got Latent
metas.description: India's Got Latent is an Indian Hindi comedy talent show hosted by Samay Raina on YouTube. Inspired by the international Got Talent franchise and Kill Tony, it features a wide variety of acts including singing, dancing, magic, and comedy.

metas.name: Spartacus
metas.description: The life of Spartacus, the gladiator who led a rebellion against the Romans.

metas.name: Euphoria
metas.description: A group of high school students navigate love and friendships in a world of drugs, sex, trauma, and social media.

metas.name: Paris Has Fallen
metas.description: A protection officer and an MI6 operative team up after a terrorist attack. They suspect a mole as they race to thwart a larger conspiracy threatening Paris.

metas.name: FROM
metas.description: Unravel the mystery of a nightmarish town in middle America that traps all those who enter. As the unwilling residents fight to keep a sense of normalcy and search for a way out, they must also survive the threats of the surrounding forest – including the terrifying creatures that come out when the sun goes down.

metas.name: Indian Game Show
metas.description: The Indian Game Show is a high-energy comedy game show created and hosted by Bharti Singh and Haarsh Limbachiyaa. Featuring popular television actors, choreographers, musicians, and social media influencers, contestants face off in physical stunts, comedy challenges, and quirky tasks to win prizes while avoiding hilarious punishments

metas.name: The Tudors
metas.description: The Tudors is a history-based drama series following the young, vibrant King Henry VIII, a competitive and lustful monarch who navigates the intrigues of the English court and the human heart with equal vigor and justifiable suspicion.

metas.name: Farzi
metas.description: Sunny, a brilliant small-time artist is catapulted into the high-stakes world of counterfeiting when he creates the perfect fake currency note, even as Michael, a fiery, unorthodox task force officer wants to rid the country of the counterfeiting menace. In this thrilling cat-and-mouse race, losing is not an option!

metas.name: Loki
metas.description: The mercurial villain Loki resumes his role as the God of Mischief in a new series that takes place after the events of “Avengers: Endgame.”

metas.name: Last Seen
metas.description: Police dispatcher Ian Ridley's daughter Maggie disappeared years ago. He receives a call, believing it's her, and embarks on a relentless quest to find her and reunite his family, disregarding consequences.

metas.name: Money Heist
metas.description: To carry out the biggest heist in history, a mysterious man called The Professor recruits a band of eight robbers who have a single characteristic: none of them has anything to lose. Five months of seclusion - memorizing every step, every detail, every probability - culminate in eleven days locked up in the National Coinage and Stamp Factory of Spain, surrounded by police forces and with dozens of hostages in their power, to find out whether their suicide wager will lead to everything or nothing.

metas.name: House of the Dragon
metas.description: An internal succession war within House Targaryen at the height of its power, 172 years before the birth of Daenerys Targaryen.

metas.name: Shrinking
metas.description: Jimmy is struggling to grieve the loss of his wife while being a dad, friend, and therapist. He decides to try a new approach with everyone in his path: unfiltered, brutal honesty. Will it make things better—or unleash uproarious chaos?

metas.name: Bandbudh Aur Budbak
metas.description: Two dim-witted 10-year-old boys, Budhdeb and Badrinath, struggle academically but excel at pranks and trouble-making. Through luck or odd logic, they escape their messes in this school comedy series.

metas.name: Monarch: Legacy of Monsters
metas.description: After surviving Godzilla's attack on San Francisco, Cate is shaken yet again by a shocking secret. Amid monstrous threats, she embarks on a globetrotting adventure to learn the truth about her family—and the mysterious organization known as Monarch.

metas.name: The Doll
metas.description: A Polish literary classic reimagined for modern times explores the dangerous intersection of love and obsession. An ambitious man's ruthless pursuit of high society status becomes entangled with his fixation on a woman named Izabela.

metas.name: Friends
metas.description: The personal and professional lives of six friends living in the Manhattan borough of New York City.

metas.name: War of the Worlds
metas.description: When astronomers detect a transmission from another galaxy, it is definitive proof of intelligent extra-terrestrial life. The world’s population waits for further contact with bated breath. They do not have to wait long. Within days, mankind is all but wiped out by a devastating attack; pockets of humanity are left in an eerily deserted world. As aliens hunt and kill those left alive, the survivors ask a burning question – who are these attackers and why are they hell-bent on our destruction?

metas.name: The Scandal
metas.description: A cunning noblewoman and a notorious playboy engage in a secret game of seduction and manipulation, drawing an innocent young widow into their dangerous romantic power play.

metas.name: No Man's Land
metas.description: Dive into the depths of the Syrian civil war through the eyes of Antoine, a young Frenchman, in search for his estranged, presumed to be dead sister. While unraveling the mystery, piece by piece, Antoine’s journey crosses paths with adventurers and anarchists, spies and innocent victims, and provides a unique look on the tragic events in Syria, and the way they affect the entire world.

metas.name: Stranger Things: Tales from '85
metas.description: Set in Hawkins, Indiana, in the winter of 1985, Eleven and her friends unravel a paranormal mystery terrorizing their town.

metas.name: Naruto: Shippûden
metas.description: Naruto Uzumaki, is a loud, hyperactive, adolescent ninja who constantly searches for approval and recognition, as well as to become Hokage, who is acknowledged as the leader and strongest of all ninja in the village.

metas.name: Philip K. Dick's Electric Dreams
metas.description: A diverse anthology of ambitious, moving tales inspired by Philip K Dick's short stories.

metas.name: The Gentlemen
metas.description: When aristocratic Eddie inherits the family estate, he discovers that it's home to a huge weed empire, and its proprietors aren't going anywhere.

metas.name: Murshid
metas.description: Murshid Pathan, a former gangster in exile, is compelled to resurface when his friend-turned-foe, Farid, forces him to take up arms once again.

metas.name: Cape Fear
metas.description: A happily married couple faces a growing threat when a notorious killer from their past, Max Cady, is released from prison and seeks revenge.

metas.name: Fleabag
metas.description: A portrait into the mind of a dry-witted, sexual, angry, porn-watching, grief-riddled woman, trying to make sense of the world. As she hurls herself headlong at modern living, Fleabag is thrown roughly up against the walls of contemporary London, with all its frenetic energy, late nights, and bright lights.

metas.name: Jujutsu Kaisen
metas.description: A boy swallows a cursed talisman - the finger of a demon - and becomes cursed himself. He enters a shaman's school to be able to locate the demon's other body parts and thus exorcise himself.

metas.name: Normal People
metas.description: Marianne and Connell weave in and out of each other's lives in this exploration of sex, power and the desire to love and be loved.
